Introduction

DiCKIDS is a South Korean underground hip-hop crew. The members frequently released solo music, collaborated with one another, and worked with other artists in the K-hip-hop industry. They also appeared on rap reality shows, including Show Me the Money and High School Rapper.

 The crew consisted of a fluctuating roster of members before their disbandment in 2019. At the time of dissolution, the remaining members were Bumby (founder and former leader), Young B (current leader), Kuzi, Bryn, Agunu, Dex, Hatts, Takoboy, Buttx3, and Raphael.

Past members include Luda, Club $ign Chicago, Artique, Newround, Bully Da Ba$tard, Papi, Loxx Punkman, and National Kido.
